name: rtdb-rules-deploy-refusals
description: Deploys one rule expression at a time through the rules REST endpoint and records whether production accepts the ruleset or refuses it, with the refusal text: method argument count and types, regular expression literals and flags, `$wildcard` variables, and snapshot operands of comparison and arithmetic operators. The prior rules are restored and read back after every attempt.

hasChildren with two string arguments.message: hasChildren() expects only a single argument (containing an array of child names).

hasChildren with one string argument.message: hasChildren() expects an array of child names.

hasChildren with an array holding a numb.message: hasChildren() expects an array of strings.

hasChildren with two arrays.message: hasChildren() expects only a single argument (containing an array of child names).

hasChildren with a data value.message: hasChildren() expects an array of child names.

replace with a number replacement.message: Argument 2 of replace() must be a string.

replace with a regex literal pattern.message: Argument 1 of replace() must be a string.

matches with a string argument.message: matches() expects a regular expression literal argument.

matches with a slash-delimited string ar.message: matches() expects a regular expression literal argument.

matches with the g flag.message: regular expressions do not support flags other than i
